_note: Written by `python -m twm.sensor_camera register`; controls tuned with `tune`. Identity is the USB port, not the serial, so re-plugging into another port means running register again. Controls are applied IN ORDER at every open and the order matters: an automatic must be written before the value it locks, because the manual value is read-only while its automatic is on. brightness stays at the camera default: it is a plain offset, so raising it lifts the black point and the picture goes milky without gaining any information. gamma is the knob that brightens, because it is a curve and leaves black at 0. exposure_time_absolute=333 is 33.3 ms, the ceiling at 30 fps. focus_absolute must be re-checked at the mounted working distance.
